Street lighting / HISTORICAL PROJECT

Light after sunset.

LUMEN · Muvattupuzha · 2022

LUMEN brought street lighting to a tribal colony in Muvattupuzha. The project was implemented in 2022 with support from EPICS in IEEE.

Local need

Street lighting was the focus of this community project.

Volunteer effort

The Kerala Section SIGHT Group put the project into practice.

Documented work

IEEE highlighted LUMEN in its 2022 Group of the Year recognition.
